title: World War I
description: Global conflict reshaping European borders, trade routes, sovereign debts, and industrial production models.

title: World War II
description: Total war engaging major world powers, leading to industrial rearmament, price controls, and the postwar Bretton Woods financial system.

title: Vietnam War & Fiscal Expansion
description: Prolonged military conflict accompanied by US domestic spending initiatives, contributing to late-1960s inflation and pressure on the gold standard.

title: Gulf War Oil Shock
description: Conflict following Iraq's invasion of Kuwait, causing short-term oil supply disruptions and energy price spikes.

title: Russia-Ukraine Conflict & Commodity Shock
description: Major conflict in Eastern Europe triggering global food and energy supply dislocations, natural gas shocks in Europe, and broad inflation pressures.
